entries.question: Is BETTER an authorized agent for these brands?
answers: No. BETTER is not an authorized agent or appointed distributor for the brands above. We provide procurement, sales and maintenance services for equipment from these Japanese brands. Brand names shown on this site are trademarks of their respective owners and are used for equipment identification only.

entries.question: Can you help evaluate and buy used equipment?
answers: Yes. We provide tool comparison, condition inspection and acceptance support, and can take on the de-installation, shipping and reinstallation that follow.

entries.question: Does AI deployment mean replacing existing tools?
answers: Not necessarily. Most use cases build on sensor, metrology and inspection data from tools you already run, and we assess data availability before deployment.

entries.question: Can training take place on our own site?
answers: Yes. Training is designed around your team's skills and tool configuration, and can combine classroom sessions with hands-on work at the tool.
